name: Doushitemo Ohimesama!
source:
The princess had lost the battle against the demon clan.
She fought to the very end, resisted with everything she had, but in the end, a lewd monster summoned by the Demon King captured her… 

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ112770.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
公主在与魔族的战斗中失败了。
她奋战到底，竭尽全力反抗，最终却被魔王召唤的淫魔俘虏了……
